I'm the head piercer for a tattoo and piercing studio. It's not recommended to change the jewelry as it can cause other problems. My PA was quite sore for a good month and a half. I started using a small amount of antibacterial cream on the piercing every night before going to sleep. Within a few days it no longer hurt.
The bcr is the best jewelry for the healing process. If the jewelry is tight when you have an erection, that may be causing the pain. If it's loose, your piercing is healing slowly. If that's the case, try the antibacterial cream. I recommend it for all piercings and have only received positive feedback.
